name: mealvest
description: Mealvest — Netlify build orchestration root. serverless-http lives here (not inside server/) because Netlify's function bundler resolves node_modules by walking up from netlify/functions/, and this is the nearest ancestor package.json on that path.

scripts.build:server-check: cd server && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:web: cd app && npm install && npx expo export --platform web
scripts.build: npm run build:server-check && npm run build:web
